leah (People Ops): Thread to capture rules for promos & comp changes for global hires (EMEA/APAC/remote-international) + visa/relocation edge cases. Please add examples.

omar (Eng Manager): We had a convert in EMEA whose local market band maps lower than US equivalent. Manager asked for US-aligned comp due to hiring market. What's allowed?

mei (Manager APAC): Common ask: align to local market rate first. If business case for US parity (critical hire/retention), managers should submit a market parity memo + director approval. Comp committee will review and may approve a bridging allowance or increased equity.

leah (People Ops): Short rules: 1) Default: apply local country band/rates. 2) Exceptions: business justification + director signoff. 3) If approved, record as either permanent band uplift or temporary "band supplement" with review date.

diego (IC EMEA): What about currency conversions and salary transparency for offers?

leah (People Ops): Use FX reference at approval date (link in toolkit) and store both local currency and USD-equivalent in the nomination. Do NOT publish USD equivalents in public comms; keep them internal for calibration.

comp-bot: :rotating_light: Reminder: include local comp benchmarking data when requesting parity exceptions. (https://go.company/global-benchmarks)

omar (Eng Manager): Visa/relocation edge case: someone relocated from LATAM to US on a visa and kept original comp for a while. Can we expedite promo to match new location?

leah (People Ops): Yes if the move caused a material role change or market mismatch. Manager should attach relocation docs + proposed target comp. For fast-track (retention risk), tag `urgent-global` and we'll triage within 72 hours.

mei (Manager APAC): Equity vesting schedules differ across regions due to local rules. If promo changes equity, who coordinates adjustments?

leah (People Ops): Recruiting + Legal coordinate equity changes cross-border. In nomination: include current grant info, legal constraints (if any), and suggested grant structure. Recruiting will return the formal grant and any required local paperwork.

payroll-bot: :money_with_wings: Payroll note: retro pay across countries may have tax/regulatory constraints. People Ops will coordinate with payroll/local payroll partners; retro amounts might be processed differently per country.

diego (IC EMEA): If bands in EMEA are frozen but we want to give a title promotion for retention, can we give a local stipend or one-time bonus?

leah (People Ops): Option: title-only + one-time retention bonus (budgeted by manager/director). Include suggested bonus amount and justification. Note: ongoing base increases need comp committee approval per region.

omar (Eng Manager): Acting-manager roles for global hires: does the 12-week rule change with timezones/short-term coverage?

leah (People Ops): Basic guidance unchanged: 12 weeks sustained acting to count as full evidence. For short urgent coverage we accept 6-8 weeks with director signoff + peer validation. Mark submission with `acting-global-short` tag.

mei (Manager APAC): Can titles be backdated across regions? E.g., promotion effective in APAC payroll earlier than US systems?

leah (People Ops): Backdating rules: up to 30 days with director approval globally. Any payroll system constraints that prevent backdate will be noted in the approval. Always include the intended effective date and the payroll-actual effective date in the notif.

comp-bot: :white_check_mark: Updated: global promo checklist template available: https://go.company/promo-toolkit/global-checklist (includes FX instructions and legal checkpoint)

diego (IC EMEA): For appeals, can we request an anonymized fairness review across regions? Weighting seems different sometimes.

leah (People Ops): Yes. Submit an audit request and mark `global-fairness` in the form. People Ops will run an anonymized cross-region calibration and report back within 10 business days. We retain anonymized stats for 2 years.

omar (Eng Manager): One practical ask: a 3-bullet manager submission template for global promos (keeps committee happy).

leah (People Ops): Use this minimal template in the nomination: ```- Summary: 1 line (role, candidate, region)
- Evidence: up to 2 artifacts (type | 1-line context | link)
- Ask: title/comp/equity/bonus + justification (1 line)
```

mei (Manager APAC): Thanks  I'll pilot this with two active cases and flag any missing pieces.

leah (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll finalize the global checklist and post a 6-min walkthrough video. DM for urgent cases and tag `urgent-global` in the form so we can escalate.
